prompt: Listen to this song. Report as JSON: total_seconds; a list of sections with start and end time in seconds (to 0.1 s) and a name (intro, verse, drum fill, chorus, outro, final chord...); for each section whether vocals are present; the exact time the lead vocal first enters; the exact time of the loudest drum fill before the first chorus and the downbeat where the full band chorus starts; the time the last chord is struck and when the audio has fully faded; the tempo in bpm; the sung lyrics as heard with a start time per line; overall quality notes (genre, any glitches, garbled words).
